# NeuroEdge AgentForge -- every Python package AgentForge's shipped code needs (ADR-0020).
#
# Installed to <project>/agentic-assets/requirements-agentforge.txt and rewritten on every
# AgentForge update. Do not edit it; reference it from your own dependency file instead:
#
#   requirements.txt / requirements-dev.txt:   -r agentic-assets/requirements-agentforge.txt
#   pyproject.toml with uv:                    uv add --group agentforge -r agentic-assets/requirements-agentforge.txt
#   neither:                                   pip install -r agentic-assets/requirements-agentforge.txt
#
# Paths are relative to THIS file's installed location (pip and uv resolve -r that way), so they
# name the target layout: the simulator is agentforge_simulator/ there, not simulator/.
#
# Software pip cannot install -- ffmpeg, Node.js, git, gh, an MQTT broker -- is listed in
# agentic-assets/docs/guides/how_to_install_agentforge.md; `python health_check/cli.py --only tools`
# reports which are missing.
#
# If this set conflicts with your own pins, reference the lines below individually instead and
# leave out requirements-voice.txt: it pulls torch, the largest and most pin-sensitive package here.
# requirements-sensor.txt (mat-io, numpy>=2.2.2) and requirements-voice.txt (numpy<2 on Python
# < 3.13) cannot share one environment: keep the voice file, and run sensor_align in its own
# environment with `uv run --no-project --with-requirements agentforge/src/requirements-sensor.txt`.

-r ../agentforge/src/requirements.txt
-r ../agentforge/src/requirements-sensor.txt
-r ../src/neuroedge_marketing/requirements.txt
-r ../src/neuroedge_marketing/requirements-voice.txt
-r ../agentforge_simulator/requirements.txt
